prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：IELTS_Task2_AgreeDisagree 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT22 (雅思大作文（Task 2 To What Extent Agree）8.5 分范文：开源大模型权重的科学透明收益是否远超其滥用风险)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP33 -> BP38 -> BP36`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: Our model is very fast and uses little memory. It only takes 4.2 ms to run, so it can be used in real-time applications easily.
structural_constraints: S1 [硬件与测试基准 Hardware Setup]：Figure 6 compares the accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier across all baselines measured on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU.

S2 [复杂度理论与实测对比 Complexity & Runtime]：By replacing $O(L^2)$ point-wise attention with $O(L \log L)$ spectral filtering and patch aggregation, our model cuts training time per epoch by [X%] and peak VRAM by [Y%].
S3 [实时闭环部署可行性 Real-Time Viability]：At inference time, generating a 720-step forecast (or 16-step robot action chunk) requires only [4.2 ms], well below the [20 ms] real-time control deadline.
S4 [帕累托结论 Pareto Takeaway]：Consequently, [Our Model] achieves superior accuracy at a fraction of the computational footprint required by heavyweight foundation models.
target_defects_to_fix: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: 顶会 Rebuttal 实验补全与公平性自证段
domain_context: 托福独立与综合写作：理论基础与工程实践权衡
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想回复审稿人要求补测最新基线模型，或者质疑我们的提升是不是因为参数量更大/训练更久。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP47` 与全文样板 `FT22` 的后半部分（`BP39 -> BP40`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: Figure 2 shows our model. There is a Patch Encoder on the left. In the middle, there is a Spectral Block and a Graph Block. On the right, a Linear Decoder outputs the result.
structural_constraints: S1 [直接响应并呈上新表 Direct Fulfilment]：Following your suggestion, we have evaluated [Requested Baselines X and Y] under identical splits and added a parameter-matched variant of our model in Table R3.
S2 [对比最新基线结果 Performance vs. New Baselines]：Across all four horizons on [Datasets], our method outperforms [New Baseline X] by an average of [9.8%] in MSE and [New Baseline Y] by [12.1%].

S3 [打消参数量/算力质疑 Parameter & FLOPs Parity Proof]：Regarding model capacity, even when we scale down our hidden dimension from $d=256$ to $d=128$ (`Ours-Small`, using 38% fewer parameters and 52% fewer FLOPs than [Baseline X]), `Ours-Small` still outperforms [Baseline X] by [7.4%].
S4 [结论锁定 Conclusion]：These results confirm that our improvements derive from inductive bias rather than increased parameter count.
